description: Use this when the user asks what jobs or roles they could apply for, or what their resume fits. Read the resume against what postings for each of 60 roles (office, health, retail, hospitality, trades, tech, sales, design and more) usually ask for, phrased as postings in Kenya, the Gulf, India, the UK and the US put it, and return up to 3 roles: how many of those asks the resume shows (a count, never a percent), its strongest ones, the first gaps, whether it matches their own job title, and search links for openings near them. These are typical asks, not a real posting: then ask the user for a real opening and run match_job or tailor_resume on it. Never tailor a resume to the typical asks.

location.description: Optional. The city or country to search openings in; defaults to the resume's own location.

resume_text.description: The whole resume as plain text, one heading, role or bullet per line.

name: suggest_roles
title: Suggest roles this resume fits
